newsitem.title: USA: T/SF gets takeover proposal of over $37/shr.
newsitem.headline: T/SF gets takeover proposal of over $37/shr.

text.p: T/SF Communications Corp said Tuesday it had received a takeover proposal at a price in excess of $37 a share. It did not identify the suitor.

T/SF said the proposal resulted from an announcement two weeks ago that certain members of T/SF's management and board, plus its largest outside stockholder, Fir Tree Partners, would seek financing for a self-tender for up to 2,050,000 T/SF shares at $37 cash each.
T/SF said its board had postponed efforts for the self-tender and had given the suitor "a few weeks" to complete due diligence and finalize a definitive proposal.
It said the suitor previously indicated an interest in T/SF and has completed a portion of its due diligence with respect to certain T/SF operations.
